flip_label_up.title: Turn the label upward
flip_label_up.caption: Find the small upside-down box on the flat lower end of the inclined induction conveyor, beside a bag. Lift the box, turn it over and release it back on that same flat section. Leave it at rest with its label facing up. Recorded in the simulator; no robot hand is shown.

mailer_to_scan.title: Move the mailer to the scanner
mailer_to_scan.caption: Recorded simulation. Lift the filled plastic mailing bag from the crate on the inspection workbench beside the inclined conveyor. Lay it flat on the same workbench in the clear scanning space in front of the handheld scanner, to the right of the keyboard.

padded_to_packing.title: Move the padded envelope
padded_to_packing.caption: Recorded simulation. On the packing workbench with the padded envelope, lift the envelope from in front of the scanner rack. Lay it flat near the middle of the same workbench’s front edge, in the clear space between the envelope’s starting spot and the mouse.

packing_drawer.title: Packing drawer
packing_drawer.caption: At the packing workbench with the padded envelope on top, pull the drawer beneath the tabletop 20 cm open. Push it fully closed and let go. Recorded in the simulator; no robot hand is shown.

tape_spool_half_turn.title: Turn the tape spool
tape_spool_half_turn.caption: Find the packing workbench with a small box on top, across the short conveyor from the workbench with the padded envelope. Turn the spool on that bench’s tape dispenser half a turn. Release it and leave the dispenser in place. Recorded mechanism test; no robot hand is shown. Blue and orange viewing marks follow the recorded spool rotation so its half-turn is visible.

roll_cage_cart.title: Roll cage cart
roll_cage_cart.caption: Find the cage cart with two boxes on its bottom deck, standing out of line beside the end wall. Roll it 1 m on its castors toward the roller chutes, keeping both boxes aboard. Stop the cart and leave it at rest. Recorded mechanism test; no robot hand is shown.

scanner_out_of_holder.title: Move the scanner
scanner_out_of_holder.caption: At the packing workbench with the padded envelope, lift the handheld scanner from its rack beside the printer. Stand it upright on the same workbench next to the mouse, on the side away from the keyboard. Let go and leave it standing. Recorded in the simulator; no robot hand is shown.
